purpose: Collect finite candidates emitted by original non-MatMul operator strategy code. A candidate is never a manually assembled tiling or a Cartesian combination of tiling fields.

collection_contract.candidate_unit: one isolated execution of one original source strategy for one documented source-input budget; every raw tiling field remains owned by that source strategy
collection_contract.accepted_candidate: the original strategy returns success, the resulting operator execution completes, and its output passes the reference comparison
collection_contract.deduplication: after the isolated original source strategy reports the complete raw tiling identity (tiling key, block dimension, byte count and raw digest); identical identities are measured once and linked to every strategy that generated them
forbidden: altering a tile, block dimension, workspace size, or tiling key after source generation
using RuntimeKb, a callback, CCE measurements, or a cost model to choose a candidate
record_from_source_or_runtime: source strategy priority or dispatch branch
tiling key, block dimension, workspace and raw tiling digest when exposed by the source/runtime
device-event latency only after correctness succeeds

extracted_installed_source.provenance: source extracted from the installed operator package; used only where the public 8.1 source does not expose the matching 910B implementation

flash_attention_score_grad.overlay_method: isolate one source registration; do not edit strategy classes, predicates, kernel, or generated tiling fields. Add an audit-only return-status passthrough. For finite candidate discovery only, accept FASG_SOURCE_AIV_CAP before source tiling and derive the matching AIC budget from the runtime's own AIC:AIV ratio; invalid caps fail closed. If the complete original-source core-budget set is still below the per-shape minimum, an explicitly labelled hardware-envelope heuristic may reduce only the source-visible L2 scheduling budget by a divisor that is no smaller than the actual physical allocation; the original source formulas generate all resulting fields.

fused_infer_attention_score.note: These are source-selected algorithm branches. They are recorded as separate source paths, not force-run as interchangeable tilings for an invalid semantic shape.

scatter_elements_v2.note: The pinned source exposes one tiler. A finite runtime-bounded AIV budget is passed to that original tiler before its own split calculation; no field is changed afterwards. The source itself only accepts its documented last-axis route.

gather_elements_v2.note: The two paths are selected by the original axis predicate. For any one semantic axis only its original path is eligible. This is explicitly a CANN-8.3-source/CANN-8.1-build compatibility port, not a claim of native 8.1 source equivalence; package build and exact installed-output equality are mandatory before a formal record.

transpose.reason: The extracted source tree has no matching 910B tiling implementation. Relabelling an arch or changing headers would not be source-preserving.

gather_v2.reason: The extracted source explicitly lacks an Ascend910B source route. It must not be faked by a header/CMake change.
